# Village of Manchester municipal roster backfill -- Vermont
# municipal fan-out batch 14; issue #163 (VT master tracking).

offices.title: Village President
offices.org_name: Village of Manchester Board of Trustees

sources.note: 24 App. V.S.A. ch. 239 (Village of Manchester): section 6: the village elects a President at the annual meeting for a one-year term; the President is ex officio one of the trustees and President of the Board
Village of Manchester, minutes of the July 2026 annual meeting: Article 5: Tom Deck was re-elected President at the July 2026 annual meeting

offices.title: Village Trustee
offices.org_name: Village of Manchester Board of Trustees

sources.note: 24 App. V.S.A. ch. 239 (Village of Manchester): section 6: two trustees are elected each year for two-year terms, so the elected trustees number four (the President sits ex officio as a fifth)
Village of Manchester, minutes of the July 2026 annual meeting: Article 5: Jim Lewis and Anthony MacLaurin were re-elected trustees at the July 2026 annual meeting (Lewis 10-1, MacLaurin unanimous)
Village of Manchester, 2026 Annual Report: the officers list seats Nina Mooney and Scott Swinarton as trustees to 2027
24 App. V.S.A. ch. 239 (Village of Manchester): section 6: the village elects three auditors at the annual meeting

Village of Manchester, minutes of the July 2026 annual meeting: the meeting's correction for the record states the village adopted staggered three-year auditor terms in 2025 (Keld Alstrup three-year, Ariel Rudiakov two-year, Amy Swinarton one-year) and Amy Swinarton was re-elected in 2026 to the three-year seat
Village of Manchester, 2026 Annual Report: the officers list names the three auditors Keld Alstrup, Ariel Rudiakov, and Amy Swinarton
24 App. V.S.A. ch. 239 (Village of Manchester): section 6: the village elects a Clerk at the annual meeting; the voters have authorized the trustees to appoint the clerk instead

Village of Manchester, minutes of the July 2026 annual meeting: Articles 6 and 7, passed in 2025 and again in 2026, authorize the Trustees to appoint the Clerk and the Treasurer/Tax Collector under 17 V.S.A. chapter 55
Village of Manchester, minutes of the Board of Trustees meeting of July 13, 2026: motion carried: 'To appoint Donald Brodie as Village Clerk'
24 App. V.S.A. ch. 239 (Village of Manchester): section 6: the village elects a Treasurer at the annual meeting; the voters have authorized the trustees to appoint the treasurer instead

Village of Manchester, minutes of the July 2026 annual meeting: Articles 6 and 7, passed in 2025 and again in 2026, authorize the Trustees to appoint the Clerk and the Treasurer/Tax Collector under 17 V.S.A. chapter 55
Village of Manchester, minutes of the Board of Trustees meeting of July 13, 2026: motion carried: 'To appoint Sarah McClintock as Treasurer and Tax Collector'
24 App. V.S.A. ch. 239 (Village of Manchester): section 6: the village elects a Tax Collector at the annual meeting; the voters have authorized the trustees to appoint the collector instead
Village of Manchester, minutes of the Board of Trustees meeting of July 13, 2026: motion carried: 'To appoint Sarah McClintock as Treasurer and Tax Collector'
